title: The axolotl
text: The axolotl is a very special animal. It lives in the lakes of Mexico City. It has a small body, four short legs and a long tail. Its face looks like it is always smiling!
The axolotl has six pink gills on its head. They look like feathers. It uses them to breathe under the water.
Axolotls have different colors. Some are pink, some are brown and some are black or gold. A pink axolotl has small black eyes.
The axolotl has a super power: it can grow its body again. If it loses a leg, a new leg grows in a few weeks. Scientists study this power.
Today there are very few axolotls in the wild. The lakes have a lot of pollution. But you can see axolotls in many aquariums, and they are also a famous animal in Minecraft!

grammar.title: Grammar: have and has
grammar.rule: Use has with he, she and it. Use have with I, you, we and they.
